test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Raghav, Manpreet, Sunaina, Prakrit, Vedika and Arwa are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Raghav is second to the left of Prakrit. Manpreet is to the immediate left of Sunaina. Arwa is second to the right of Vedika. There are an equal number of persons between Raghav and Manpreet from both the ends. Who is sitting third to the left of Sunanina?
solution:
Given: Six persons Raghav, Manpreet, Sunaina, Prakrit, Vedika and Arwa are sitting around a circular table facing the center.

**1.** Raghav is second to the left of Prakrit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73cdb6efceecb3e7381c7a54ba423b9dd69747bb46795594b06b0ad8700f24a9.png] 

**2.** Manpreet is to the immediate left of Sunaina. So, there are two possibilities for the position of Sunaina and Manpreet.

 
• **Case(1):**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/000fdd3cdc2fd2d3edde838279d9367bbc650f615cb24b1c8a6410c58989203b.png] 

 
• **Case(2):**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e853d439440f43e7d86c2ffa2a1bdc35b5fd4b47cc004c9e90c08f6ac54c0cc.png] 

3. There are an equal number of persons between Raghav and Manpreet from both the ends.

 
• Case(1): There are an equal number of persons i.e two between Raghav and Manpreet from both the ends.
 
• Case(2): There are an unequal number of persons between Raghav and Manpreet i.e one and three between Raghav and Manpreet from both the ends respectively.

**⇒ Thus **Case(2)** will be eliminated.**

**4.** Arwa is second to the right of Vedika.

 
• Case(1):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4b74795933c820dd1c98af3d43947c4884852eb0bfc9b30eb7dc61f7451c495.png] 

Thus, from the final arrangement we can see that 'Arwa' is sitting third to the left of Sunaina.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Arwa"**.
